meta.title: Ferro & Lane — a poster of an architecture studio
meta.description: A small architecture practice as a poster: a headline over the corner of a picture, an orange disc, a turned caption, a ruled ledger of ten buildings, three pictures and a big number, two partners, notes, and a contact form. Built from a gogh site definition with Unsplash pictures.
meta.author: jamiemarsland
